potion-salesman.note: Potion salesman: a figure on the player's paper-doll frames, so the same geometry as every other figure sheet. Body rounded from the silhouette; the top two rows of the head (hair, hat, helmet) face up and a little north; from row 10 down the legs and feet round across the row only, so they stand vertical rather than curling under like the end of a blob. Every townsfolk tile draws these same pixels, so their entries must stay identical.
